description: The skill catalog this environment installs at container start. It is a MANIFEST, not a vendored tree: nothing in it is stored in this repository, and `npx skills` fetches each entry into the discovery path (/root/.agents/skills, the clone's .agents/skills) at run time. See bin/dsh-state.sh.
sourcesVerified: Each `source` below was confirmed against the copy this repository used to vendor, by computing the Skills CLI's own folder hash (sha256 over sorted path+content, .git and node_modules skipped) for the vendored directory and for a fresh install of the source. 17 of the 21 matched byte for byte. `i-have-adhd` is the same skill as the vendored copy but has moved on upstream - which is the drift this manifest exists to stop following by hand. The three entries pointing at ./.agents/local are ours, or have no confirmed upstream, and are recorded in .agents/local/README.md.
